fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2008 Hyundai Veracruz SUV.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on both front headlights
Paint on hood and front bumper looks flat and dull rather than glossy
Faded gray-black plastic trim along the lower rear bumper
Water spotting and light film visible on the rear hatch glass and lower rear bumper
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Veracruz. From the photos the headlight lenses look a bit hazy and the paint on the hood and bumpers has gone flat, which a buff and polish can usually brighten up a lot. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you, including trim restoration on the rear bumper plastic. Would you like a quote?
